cases.description: A valid chain with every kind of record: create, invite, confirm, rekey, role, remove, grant, ungrant, collection, move, collection-delete, group, group-members, group-delete, rename, seal, keys, policies, recovery-key, recovery-key-clear and fence.
cases.name: valid-every-kind

cases.name: owners-ungrant-by-the-other-owner

cases.name: owners-grant-to-group-by-the-other-owner

cases.description: A record with a bad link and a bad signature is a bad link.

description: The space chain (docs/crypto.md, "Space chain"). `link` cases pin the labelled hash link: link = SHA-256("kemlock/v1/space-chain/link" || record bytes), the spec's two examples; `encoding` cases are records a reader must refuse as malformed; the `signing` case pins the signing input, "kemlock/v1/sig1" || lp("space-chain") || lp(record), and a record signature; `seals` cases pin commitments: seal hash = SHA-256(box), digest, key check, and each recipient's box with its context and aad; `chain` cases are chains of records (the first case is a valid chain with every kind; a chain that has `base` and `prefix` starts with that many records of the base chain) with the verdict a verifier must give: accepted with the head, or refused with the reason and the seq. A chain with an `anchor` is verified against it. Bytes are lower-case hex, except that `record` and `link_b64url` are text.
